case.title: Shadows over the Sea
case.introduction: A glittering gala is hosted at the secluded Marina View Villa, where the world’s elite gather to celebrate the unveiling of a priceless painting. Amidst champagne and whispers, the villa’s owner is found dead, and the guests must uncover the murderer before the night ends.
case.crime: Victor Hale, the wealthy art collector, is discovered stabbed to death in his private Study during the gala.
case.escape_plan: Board the private helicopter on the rooftop helipad at midnight and fly to an undisclosed location.

rooms.name: Grand Hall
rooms.description: The opulent main ballroom filled with chandeliers, a stage for the unveiling, and a sea‑view terrace.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: A quiet room lined with rare books and a hidden safe behind a movable bookshelf.

rooms.name: Garden Terrace
rooms.description: An outdoor lounge with a fountain, surrounded by hedges that conceal a service entrance.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: Victor's private office, a heavy oak desk, a locked safe, and a wall of priceless artwork.

rooms.name: Helipad
rooms.description: A rooftop landing pad with a small private helicopter and a panoramic view of the coastline.

characters.name: Victor Hale
characters.background: Owner of Marina View Villa, built his fortune on art deals, secretly siphoning insurance money after a fire years ago.
characters.secret: Embezzling insurance funds from a past fire at the villa
characters.goal: Secure his legacy and ensure his family inherits the estate
characters.alibi: Was in the Study reviewing documents until the power flicker

relationships.detail: Invited Sofia to the gala as a guest of honor

knowledge: Location of the safe in the Library
lies: I was in the Study the whole time
I never argued with my brother

characters.name: Eleanor Hale
characters.background: Victor’s younger sister, manages the family’s legal affairs, hides an affair with the villa’s chef to fund her own investments.
characters.secret: Having an affair with Chef Damien Ortiz
characters.goal: Protect the family’s reputation and keep Victor’s crimes hidden
characters.alibi: Was on the Garden Terrace speaking with guests after the unveiling

relationships.detail: Constant power struggle over the estate

lies: I was never close to Damien

characters.name: Sofia Marquez
characters.background: Appears as a benefactor, but is actually Lara Voss, a renowned art thief planning to steal the newly unveiled painting.
characters.secret: Mastermind behind the theft of the painting and Victor’s murder
characters.goal: Steal the painting and escape via helicopter
characters.alibi: Was on the Helipad arranging a charity helicopter ride for a children’s hospital

relationships.detail: Victor invited her as a guest of honor
Mira trusts Sofia and often shares security updates

knowledge: Location of the safe and its combination
lies: I was alone on the Helipad at 8:30 PM

characters.name: Damien Ortiz
characters.personality: Hot‑tempered but proud of his cuisine
characters.background: Head chef of the villa’s kitchen, deep in gambling debts, hopes a big payout will clear them.
characters.secret: Owes a dangerous loan shark money he can’t repay
characters.goal: Find a quick way to get cash, possibly by exploiting the chaos
characters.alibi: Was in the Kitchen preparing desserts for the after‑party
knowledge: The kitchen’s back door leads to the Garden Terrace

characters.name: Mira Patel
characters.background: Oversees villa security, once falsified logs to cover a breach, now fears exposure.
characters.secret: Altered security footage timestamps to hide a gap during the murder
characters.goal: Maintain her spotless record and prevent any scandal from reaching the press
characters.alibi: Patrolling the perimeter, checking cameras, and later supervising the crime scene
knowledge: Exact location of the hidden safe
lies: I saw Sofia near the Helipad at 8:30 PM
The footage from 9:00‑9:05 PM is intact

timeline.description: Guests arrive, mingling in the Grand Hall; introductions are made.
Victor announces the unveiling of the painting “The Siren”.
A brief power flicker darkens the Villa for about one minute; guests gasp as lights return.
A scream echoes; Victor is found dead in the Study, a deep stab wound to the chest.
Mira seals all exits, begins interviewing guests; Eleanor claims she was on the Garden Terrace; Damien says he was in the Kitchen.
Forensic team collects evidence; the designer clutch is discovered near the Study entrance.

evidence.name: Lockpick Set
evidence.description: A set of finely crafted lockpicks hidden in Sofia’s clutch, matching the marks on the Library safe’s lock.

evidence.name: Bloodied Chef’s Knife
evidence.description: A chef’s knife with Victor’s blood; the knife bears a discreet engraving belonging to the villa’s kitchen staff.

evidence.name: Security Footage Gap
evidence.description: Missing footage from 9:00‑9:05 PM; timestamps show deliberate deletion.

evidence.name: Phone Record
evidence.description: Victor’s phone shows an outgoing call at 9:02 PM to an unknown number registered to Lara Voss’s alias.

evidence.name: Cufflink with Blood
evidence.description: Victor’s golden cufflink found on the floor beside the body, smeared with his own blood; it was planted after the murder.

hidden_clues: A torn piece of a map with helipad coordinates tucked inside a book in the Library
Sofia’s clutch contains a hidden compartment holding a microfilm of the painting’s security code
red_herrings: The missing security footage suggests an insider sabotage
The chef’s debt gives him a clear motive to eliminate Victor
Victor’s embezzlement could have provoked a family revenge

solution.target_true_identity: Lara Voss, internationally known art thief
solution.reasoning: The lockpick set and the phone record directly link Sofia to the safe and to a call made at the exact moment of Victor’s death, contradicting her alibi on the Helipad. The cufflink and chef’s knife were planted to mislead, while Mira’s altered footage was an attempt to hide the brief window when the murderer escaped. Combined with the hidden map and microfilm, the evidence points unequivocally to Sofia’s true identity as Lara Voss, who staged the murder to obtain the painting and flee via helicopter.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
